title.zh: 【Zilliqa 更新安全事件进展：部分跨链资产受影响，CEO 已辞职】
title.en: 【Zilliqa 更新安全事件进展：部分跨链资产受影响，CEO 已辞职】

current_state.zh: Zilliqa 安全事件调查仍在进行，X-Bridge 继续暂停，受影响代币包括 zUSDT、SEED、kUSD 与 Zoge；官方正在轮换全部运营密钥，CEO Alexander Zahnd 已辞职，董事会直接接管并获外部安全与治理顾问协助，同时与交易平台和执法部门合作。
current_state.en: Zilliqa's investigation is ongoing; X-Bridge remains paused, affected tokens include zUSDT, SEED, kUSD and Zoge, all operational keys are being rotated, CEO Alexander Zahnd has resigned, and the board has taken direct control with external security and governance advisers while cooperating with exchanges and law enforcement.

updates.title_zh: 【Zilliqa 更新安全事件进展：部分跨链资产受影响，CEO 已辞职】
updates.title_en: 【Zilliqa 更新安全事件进展：部分跨链资产受影响，CEO 已辞职】
updates.what_changed_zh: Zilliqa 表示，其 X-Bridge 及部分流动性池使用的 ZRC2 代理合约在一起安全事件中受到影响，已暂停 X-Bridge，开始轮换运营密钥，并宣布 CEO Alexander Zahnd 辞职。
updates.what_changed_en: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and ZRC2 proxy contracts used by certain liquidity pools were affected in a security incident, paused X-Bridge, began rotating operational keys, and announced CEO Alexander Zahnd's resignation.
updates.current_state_zh: Zilliqa 表示，其 X-Bridge 及部分流动性池使用的 ZRC2 代理合约在一起安全事件中受到影响，已暂停 X-Bridge，开始轮换运营密钥，并宣布 CEO Alexander Zahnd 辞职。
updates.current_state_en: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and ZRC2 proxy contracts used by certain liquidity pools were affected in a security incident, paused X-Bridge, began rotating operational keys, and announced CEO Alexander Zahnd's resignation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and ZRC2 proxy contracts used by certain liquidity pools were affected in a security incident, paused X-Bridge, began rotating operational keys, and announced CEO Alexander Zahnd's resignation.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and ZRC2 proxy contracts used by certain liquidity pools were affected in a security incident, paused X-Bridge, began rotating operational keys, and announced CEO Alexander Zahnd's resignation.

updates.title_zh: Zilliqa更新安全事件进展：X-Bridge继续暂停，CEO主动离职
updates.title_en: Zilliqa更新安全事件进展：X-Bridge继续暂停，CEO主动离职
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增受影响代币为 zUSDT、SEED、kUSD 与 Zoge，原生 ZIL 与 Zilliqa EVM 网络未受影响；董事会已直接接管，并由网络安全与治理外部顾问协助，同时与交易平台及执法部门合作。
updates.what_changed_en: Added that affected tokens include zUSDT, SEED, kUSD and Zoge, while native ZIL and the Zilliqa EVM network were unaffected; the board has taken direct control with external cybersecurity and governance advisers, and the company is cooperating with exchanges and law enforcement.
updates.current_state_zh: Zilliqa 安全事件调查仍在进行，X-Bridge 继续暂停，受影响代币包括 zUSDT、SEED、kUSD 与 Zoge；官方正在轮换全部运营密钥，CEO Alexander Zahnd 已辞职，董事会直接接管并获外部安全与治理顾问协助，同时与交易平台和执法部门合作。
updates.current_state_en: Zilliqa's investigation is ongoing; X-Bridge remains paused, affected tokens include zUSDT, SEED, kUSD and Zoge, all operational keys are being rotated, CEO Alexander Zahnd has resigned, and the board has taken direct control with external security and governance advisers while cooperating with exchanges and law enforcement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and several ZRC2 proxy contracts tied to zUSDT, SEED, kUSD and Zoge were compromised, keeping the bridge paused and rotating operational keys while CEO Alexander Zahnd resigned and the board took direct control pending external security and governance advisers.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Zilliqa reported that its X-Bridge and several ZRC2 proxy contracts tied to zUSDT, SEED, kUSD and Zoge were compromised, keeping the bridge paused and rotating operational keys while CEO Alexander Zahnd resigned and the board took direct control pending external security and governance advisers.
